digest.component_or_area: mapping seam configuration and integration documentation
propositions: The mapping seam configuration surface ([tool.rebar.mapping]) lacks authoritative documentation covering axis catalog, merge layers, and per-project keying.
Future integrators (Linear, GitLab, GitHub-Issues) need a documented provider-neutral reuse contract and core abstraction distinct from Jira-adapter specifics.
The feature must demonstrate portability: every mapping behavior exercised by injected-transport unit tests with no live Jira dependency and no specific CI provider requirement.
The feature is additive and backward-compatible: absent [tool.rebar.mapping] section reproduces current hardcoded behavior; rollback requires only section deletion without store migration.
